actions.comment: 5 uses, every 30.7 s: a gaze (missed every time). Retail (questkit rates, 2026-11-21: 2 casts by 2 of the duty fixtures' NPCs): first 5.4 to 6 s after the pull (median 5.7; `first_uses`: each NPC draws one of retail's each fight), `every` kept (retail's: 32 s, never twice by one: the longest any of them fought). Before, the rotation would have cast it 3 times at most over lives retail's cast it 2.

23 uses beside 32 auto-attacks: about every other swing. Retail (questkit rates, 2026-11-21: 8 casts by 2 of the duty fixtures' NPCs): first 10.6 to 11.2 s after the pull (median 10.9; `first_uses`: each NPC draws one of retail's each fight), `every` kept (retail's: 3.1 s, the median of 6 times between one's uses). Before, the rotation would have cast it 9 times at most over lives retail's cast it 8.

comment: Haukke Manor's BNpcBase 14698 (level 28, 3630 HP): auto-attack 870 and 970 by turns, a gaze (29709) every 30.7 s; 29710 (a gaze too, three uses) isn't in its rotation.
